review_scope.method: Read-only source and call-site inspection at fixed P, keyword/path scan of 187 root src Rust files across the three scoped crates, detailed examination of the named owner families, and exact Git/content equality for the catalogue evidence. No compilation or new test execution.
limits: This is a bounded static ownership inventory, not a compiler-derived complete call graph or proof that every remaining duplicate has been ruled out.
Third-party benchmark sources, frozen fixtures, independent test references and separate wire schema domains are not deletion candidates solely because text or names resemble production code.
No source, configuration, task definition, dependency, status or remote change was made by this inventory.
review_scope.original_acceptance_boundary: P8-017 original dependency and V18/V21 acceptance requirements remain in force. This inventory and the bounded tests do not complete those requirements.

outstanding_ownership_item.description: The local execution registry and the query policy obligation builder independently enumerate the ordered local lane catalogue.

execution_owner.role: Selects executable local lane implementations and preserves fusion/annotation order.

policy_owner.role: Produces ordered per-lane intent roles and child budgets, then conditionally adds semantic obligations; fingerprint serializes the policy.

equality_evidence.method: Read fixed-P Git blobs; extract default_lanes concrete registration order, resolve each RetrievalLane::lane_id constant from its impl, and compare to QueryPolicy::resolve literal array. Assert both exactly equal the stated ordered IDs.
equality_evidence.claim_limit: No current catalogue mismatch or user-visible failure was observed. The remaining issue is ownership and future manual synchronization.

outstanding_ownership_item.later_bounded_action: Choose one shared ordered local-lane descriptor/catalogue for both consumers, or document and justify why separate owners are necessary. This action was not performed in P.
compatibility_requirements: Preserve current local lane execution and fusion order.
Preserve disabled and zero-weight lane receipt obligations, intent roles and child budgets.
Preserve conditional semantic lane inclusion and existing serialized QueryPolicy/fingerprint values for the unchanged catalogue.
verification_for_later_change: Compare before/after serialized policy and fingerprints across supported strategies and intents.
Compare registered execution IDs and policy obligation IDs including disabled and zero-weight cases.
Run existing lane registry, fusion, policy and affected integration regressions.
outstanding_ownership_item.existing_test_limit: default_lanes_registry_keeps_fusion_order asserts current order; policy tests cover current roles and fingerprints. These tests do not make one production catalogue derive from the other.
